entities.name: Adam Mickiewicz Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Adam Mickiewicz Museum is a historic house museum dedicated to the life of Adam Mickiewicz, renowned Polish poet. It is located in the district of Beyoğlu, on the European side of Istanbul, Turkey.
